title: 三角龙的角
subtitle: 三只角和一块大盾
character: wearing a mustard yellow t-shirt, olive shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, thick wax crayon drawing with grainy strokes, clay red, mustard yellow and dusty green

pages.zh:
这个头
比我整个人还高。
上面有三只角，
后面还顶着
一块大大的盾。
pages.scene: The little boy stands beside a huge triceratops skull in a museum, looking up at it, his head no higher than the skull's beak.

pages.zh:
它的角一共三只。
鼻子上一只短的，
两只眼睛上面
各有一只长的。
所以它叫三角龙。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one triceratops head seen from the front on a cream background with one short horn on the nose and one long horn above each eye, three horns in total. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
眼睛上面那两只角，
有一米那么长，
比大人的胳膊还长。
尖尖的，
谁也不敢乱碰。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one long pointed horn shape lying beside one outstretched adult arm outline on a cream background, the horn clearly longer. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
脖子后面那块大盾，
是骨头长出来的。
它一低头，
盾正好
挡在脖子前面。
pages.scene: One triceratops seen from the side on a cream background with its head lowered so the bony frill shields its neck. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
这块盾有什么用呢？
能挡住咬过来的嘴，
能撑得很大吓唬对手，
同伴远远看见，
也认得出是自己人。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three small triceratops head shapes in a row on a cream background, the first with a bite mark stopped at the frill, the second with the frill drawn extra wide, the third with a patterned frill. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
两只三角龙
也会打架。
角对着角
顶来顶去，
谁先退开谁就算输。
pages.scene: Two triceratops facing each other on a cream background with their horns locked together, pushing. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的嘴像鸟喙，
又硬又尖，
专门剪断粗树枝。
后面的牙
再把叶子磨碎。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one triceratops jaw seen from the side on a cream background, the front drawn as a hard pointed beak and the back as rows of flat grinding teeth. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它有四条腿，
又粗又壮。
身体那么重，
走起路来
地面都跟着抖。
pages.scene: One triceratops walking on four thick sturdy legs on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它有多大呢？
和一辆小汽车
差不多长，
可是要重得多，
三辆车加起来才够。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one triceratops silhouette and one car shape standing one above the other on a cream background, exactly the same length. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它们常常
一大群走在一起。
小的走在中间，
大的围在外面，
角全都朝着外面。
pages.scene: Five big triceratops standing in a wide ring on a cream background, each one with its tail towards the centre of the ring and its horned head pointing away outward, two small ones standing together in the empty middle.

pages.zh:
它的头骨又大又硬，
埋在泥沙里
不容易碎。
所以我们挖出来的
三角龙头骨特别多。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one cross-section of layered ground on a cream background with one large triceratops skull embedded in the middle layer. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我摸了摸
那块盾的边。
凉凉的，硬硬的。
它到底
顶过多少次呢？
pages.scene: The little boy reaches up and touches the edge of the triceratops skull's frill with one hand, thoughtful.
